mapper.select: SELECT * FROM accounting_subjects WHERE deleted = 0 AND (subject_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY subject_code ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM accounting_subjects WHERE deleted = 0 AND parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY subject_code ASC

SELECT a.* FROM accounting_subjects a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM accounting_subjects b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.parent_id = a.subject_id ) ORDER BY a.subject_code ASC
